column1: # HOTD2 function names — the committed source of truth for the Ghidra database.
# Addresses are virtual, lower-case hex, no 0x prefix.
# Regenerate from a live database with:   ./ghidra/run.sh export-annotations
# Replay onto a fresh import with:        ./ghidra/run.sh apply-annotations
# ApplyAnnotations only renames a symbol whose current name is still a Ghidra
# default (FUN_/SUB_/LAB_/DAT_/UNK_), so re-applying is idempotent and never
# clobbers a name a human chose in the GUI.
# Names recovered by Ghidra's own analysers (CRT, D3DX, Catch@/Unwind@) are
# deliberately NOT listed: auto-analysis recreates them on import.
